entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana... I hope you can help. I bought some cycling shoes a while back, and... well, they just haven't worked out for me at all. I was hoping I could return them.
I'm sorry to hear the shoes aren't working for you. I can certainly look into that. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with them?

They just hurt so much. I've tried everything, but they keep giving me terrible blisters on my heels. And I could never get the cleats adjusted right, my knees always felt off after a ride. I saved up for so long for these... I feel awful about it.

Oh, that sounds very uncomfortable. Getting blisters instead of enjoying a ride is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Do you have your order number handy so I can pull up the details?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. I've been a loyal customer for years, I just... I really need this money back. Things are a bit tight right now.
I understand completely. Thank you for that order number. Let me just check our policy... one moment.
Okay, I've got your order right here. I see you purchased the cycling shoes 84 days ago. You're in luck! Our standard return policy is 90 days.
Oh, really? So I can still return them?
Yes, absolutely. Since you're within the 90-day window, I can go ahead and process this return for a full refund for you. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label right now.
Wow. Oh, thank you so much, Diana! That's such a relief. I was so worried. You've really helped me out today.

You're very welcome. I'm glad we could get this sorted out for you. The email is on its way. Just print the label, attach it to the box with the shoes inside, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, Diana. You've been wonderful.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
